parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include conversation information.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要对话信息

不填默认为false
parameters.name: with_conversations

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

ActualTime.description_en: The actual execution time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ActualTime.description_zh: 实际执行时间。使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

Action.description_en:
The instruction. Valid values:
BeginDialogue: starts the conversation.
Dialogue: indicates a conversation.
AbortDialogue: aborts the conversation.
SilenceTimeout: indicates a silence timeout.
CollectedNumber: indicates a collected number.
EndDialogue: ends the conversation.
Broadcast: indicates an opening remark.
HangUp: hangs up the call.
Authorize: grants authorization.
TransferToAgent: transfers the call to an agent.
TransferToIVR: transfers the call to an IVR.
RedirectToPage: redirects to a page.
CollectNumber: collects a number.
WaitOnAsyncTask: waits for an asynchronous task.
Error: indicates an error
Action.description_zh:
指令
BeginDialogue：开始对话
Dialogue：对话
AbortDialogue：中止对话
SilenceTimeout：静音超时
CollectedNumber：已收集号码
-EndDialogue：结束对话
Broadcast：开场白
HangUp挂断
Authorize：授权
TransferToAgent：转接坐席
TransferToIVR：转接IVR
RedirectToPage：重定向页面
CollectNumber：收集号码
WaitOnAsyncTask：等待异步任务
Error：错误

Speaker.description_en: The speaker of the conversation. Valid values: Robot and Contact
Speaker.description_zh: 对话是谁说的，Robot 机器人 ，Contact 联系人

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the summary was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 摘要创建时间。使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

EndReason.description_en:
The end reason. Valid values:
FINISHED: normal completion.
CHATBOT_HANGUP_AFTER_NOANSWER: the robot hangs up after unrecognized input.
CHATBOT_HANGUP_AFTER_SILENCE: the robot hangs up after a silence timeout.
CLIENT_HANGUP_AFTER_NOANSWER: the user hangs up after unrecognized input.
CLIENT_HANGUP: the user hangs up without a reason.
TRANSFER_BY_INTENT: the call is transferred to a human agent due to intent matching.
TRANSFER_AFTER_NOANSWER: the call is transferred to a human agent after unrecognized input.
INO_INTERACTION: no interaction from the user.
ERROR: the system is interrupted due to an exception.
SPECIAL_INTERCEPT_VOICE_ASSISTANT: intercepted due to special circumstances - voice assistant.
SPECIAL_INTERCEPT_EXTENSION_NUMBER_TRANSFER: intercepted due to special circumstances - extension number transfer.

<notice>The data type of this parameter is String. The returned value is an enumerated value such as FINISHED.</notice>
EndReason.description_zh:
结束原因
FINISHED(1, "正常完结"),
CHATBOT_HANGUP_AFTER_NOANSWER(2, "拒识后机器人挂机"),
CHATBOT_HANGUP_AFTER_SILENCE(3, "静默超时挂机"),
CLIENT_HANGUP_AFTER_NOANSWER(4, "拒识后用户挂机"),
CLIENT_HANGUP(5, "用户无理由挂机"),
TRANSFER_BY_INTENT(6, "命中意图转人工"),
TRANSFER_AFTER_NOANSWER(7, "拒识转人工"),

INO_INTERACTION(8, "用户侧无交互"),

ERROR(9, "系统异常中断"),

SPECIAL_INTERCEPT_VOICE_ASSISTANT(10, "特殊情况拦截-语音助手"),
SPECIAL_INTERCEPT_EXTENSION_NUMBER_TRANSFER(11, "特殊情况拦截-分机号转接")

<notice>该参数类型为string，返回的为FINISHED之类的枚举值></notice>

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
